parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
a AS (
  INSERT INTO alerts (
    schema_version, alert_id, source, source_event_id, category, subtype,
    status, event_action, title, message, priority, county, municipality,
    location, tags, click_url, source_url, observed_at, source_updated_at,
    received_at, expires_at, metadata, raw_payload, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p->'alert'->>'schema_version', '1.0'),
    p->'alert'->>'alert_id',
    p->'alert'->>'source',
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'source_event_id', ''),
    p->'alert'->>'category',
    p->'alert'->>'subtype',
    p->'alert'->>'status',
    p->'alert'->>'event_action',
    p->'alert'->>'title',
    p->'alert'->>'message',
    (p->'alert'->>'priority')::integer,
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'county', ''),
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'municipality', ''),
    COALESCE(p->'alert'->'location', '{}'::jsonb),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p->'alert'->'tags', '[]'::jsonb))),
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'click_url', ''),
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'source_url', ''),
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'observed_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'source_updated_at', '')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'received_at', '')::timestamptz, NOW()),
    NULLIF(p->'alert'->>'expires_at', '')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE(p->'alert'->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb),
    p->'alert',
    NOW()
  FROM d
  ON CONFLICT (alert_id) DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    event_action = EXCLUDED.event_action,
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    message = EXCLUDED.message,
    priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT d.p AS matcher_output
FROM d CROSS JOIN a;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
refs AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    a.id AS alert_uuid,
    s.id AS subscriber_uuid,
    concat_ws(
      '|',
      p->>'alert_id',
      p->>'subscriber_id',
      COALESCE(p->>'event_action', ''),
      md5(concat_ws(
        '|',
        COALESCE(p->>'title', ''),
        COALESCE(p->>'message', ''),
        COALESCE(p->>'priority', ''),
        COALESCE((p->'tags')::text, '[]'),
        COALESCE(p->>'click', '')
      ))
    ) AS delivery_key
  FROM input
  LEFT JOIN alerts a
    ON a.alert_id = p->>'alert_id'
  LEFT JOIN subscribers s
    ON s.subscriber_id = p->>'subscriber_id'
),
attempt AS (
  INSERT INTO deliveries (
    delivery_key,
    alert_id,
    subscriber_id,
    ntfy_topic,
    status,
    attempted_at,
    sent_at,
    error_message,
    matched_watch_ids,
    match_reasons
  )
  SELECT
    delivery_key,
    alert_uuid,
    subscriber_uuid,
    p->>'ntfy_topic',
    'PENDING',
    NOW(),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    COALESCE(p->'matched_watch_ids', '[]'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(p->'match_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM refs
  WHERE alert_uuid IS NOT NULL
    AND subscriber_uuid IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (delivery_key) DO UPDATE SET
    status = 'PENDING',
    attempted_at = NOW(),
    sent_at = NULL,
    error_message = NULL,
    matched_watch_ids = EXCLUDED.matched_watch_ids,
    match_reasons = EXCLUDED.match_reasons
  WHERE deliveries.status = 'FAILED'
  RETURNING
    id::text AS delivery_uuid,
    delivery_key,
    status,
    attempted_at,
    true AS should_send
),
existing AS (
  SELECT
    d.id::text AS delivery_uuid,
    d.delivery_key,
    d.status,
    d.attempted_at,
    false AS should_send
  FROM refs r
  JOIN deliveries d
    ON d.delivery_key = r.delivery_key
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM attempt a WHERE a.delivery_key = r.delivery_key
  )
),
invalid AS (
  SELECT
    NULL::text AS delivery_uuid,
    delivery_key,
    'INVALID'::text AS status,
    NOW() AS attempted_at,
    false AS should_send
  FROM refs
  WHERE alert_uuid IS NULL OR subscriber_uuid IS NULL
),
choice AS (
  SELECT * FROM attempt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM existing
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM invalid
)
SELECT
  r.p AS payload,
  c.delivery_uuid,
  c.delivery_key,
  c.status AS reservation_status,
  c.attempted_at,
  c.should_send,
  CASE
    WHEN r.alert_uuid IS NULL THEN 'Alert ID not found in alerts table'
    WHEN r.subscriber_uuid IS NULL THEN 'Subscriber ID not found in subscribers table'
    WHEN c.status = 'SENT' THEN 'Exact delivery already sent'
    WHEN c.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'Exact delivery already pending'
    WHEN c.status = 'FAILED' THEN 'Previous failed delivery eligible for retry'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS reservation_reason
FROM refs r
JOIN choice c USING (delivery_key);

WITH d AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
u AS (
  UPDATE deliveries
  SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN COALESCE((d.p->>'sent')::boolean, false) THEN 'SENT'
      ELSE 'FAILED'
    END,
    sent_at = CASE
      WHEN COALESCE((d.p->>'sent')::boolean, false) THEN NOW()
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    error_message = CASE
      WHEN COALESCE((d.p->>'sent')::boolean, false) THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.p->>'delivery_error', ''), 'ntfy sender returned sent=false')
    END,
    matched_watch_ids = COALESCE(d.p->'matched_watch_ids', deliveries.matched_watch_ids),
    match_reasons = COALESCE(d.p->'match_reasons', deliveries.match_reasons),
    ntfy_message_id = NULLIF(d.p->>'ntfy_message_id', ''),
    ntfy_response = COALESCE(d.p->'ntfy_response', deliveries.ntfy_response)
  FROM d
  WHERE deliveries.delivery_key = d.p->>'delivery_key'
  RETURNING
    deliveries.id::text AS delivery_uuid,
    deliveries.delivery_key,
    deliveries.status,
    deliveries.attempted_at,
    deliveries.sent_at,
    deliveries.error_message,
    deliveries.ntfy_message_id,
    deliveries.matched_watch_ids,
    deliveries.match_reasons
)
SELECT
  d.p->>'alert_id' AS alert_id,
  d.p->>'subscriber_id' AS subscriber_id,
  d.p->>'subscriber_name' AS subscriber_name,
  d.p->>'ntfy_topic' AS ntfy_topic,
  false AS suppressed,
  u.*
FROM d CROSS JOIN u;
